premises: TiO precipitates can form in refractory high-entropy alloys containing Ti when oxygen is introduced during processing.
TiO precipitates act as a strengthening phase in BCC refractory high-entropy alloys.
Precipitation strengthening by fine, stable particles can impede dislocation motion and retain strength at high temperatures.
The TiVNbTa alloy system is chemically similar enough to the cited systems that TiO precipitation is feasible and beneficial.
